compositionOrder: write the source-verified Persian alif carrier downward according to its normal positional rule
add maddah above as a short horizontal wave

compositionSource.citation: The Unicode Consortium, The Unicode Standard, Version 17.0, Arabic Core Specification §9.2 and Arabic names list, U+0622 ARABIC LETTER ALEF WITH MADDA ABOVE = U+0627 ALEF + U+0653 ARABIC MADDAH ABOVE (2025)
compositionSource.variation: Unicode identifies maddah as a special harakat mark and canonically decomposes precomposed آ into the alef carrier followed by U+0653 ARABIC MADDAH ABOVE. The Persian curriculum composes its separately source-verified alif path with the wave-shaped mark instead of inventing a duplicate letter ductus. Unicode specifies encoded composition and placement, not a universal handwriting sequence or stroke direction; carrier-first is an explicit learner convention.
